mainEntity.name: How much does crypto Telegram and Discord community marketing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A traditional crypto marketing agency charges $15K–$45K/month because the retainer covers a multi-person team. A fractional senior operator runs the same scope for $5K–$12K/month. KOL fees are separate and depend on tier: nano KOLs run $200–$1.5K per post, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K, and macro $25K–$100K+. A single launch seeding sprint typically runs $15K–$40K all-in over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which KOLs and platforms will you use for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: KOL selection depends on your vertical, your target community profile and your stage. For DePIN and infrastructure projects, that is typically mid-tier technical KOLs with high-quality followings. For consumer token launches, a mix of nano and micro KOLs across Telegram, X and YouTube delivers better cost-per-engaged-member than one macro name. All KOLs in the network are vetted for real engagement, not inflated follower counts. Community seeding runs on Telegram and Discord simultaneously where relevant.
